scenarios.name: regular_only
scenarios.note: control: REGULAR buys only, what B1 already runs

scenarios.name: exited_still_held
scenarios.note: CCC left the index and is still held: a holding only, never bought

scenarios.name: liquidated_proceeds_waiting
scenarios.note: CCC sold in full at a gain; the proceeds wait for the redeploy answer

scenarios.name: liquidated_then_regular
scenarios.note: a scheduled buy after the sale does not spend the proceeds

scenarios.name: liquidated_redeployed
scenarios.note: the proceeds redeployed in full into the underweight members

scenarios.name: liquidated_redeploy_partial
scenarios.note: one redeploy fill short of the proceeds: the rest is still offered

scenarios.name: liquidated_redeploy_declined
scenarios.note: the user answered No: the offset makes the offer zero, the cash stays counted

scenarios.name: liquidated_declined_then_sold_again
scenarios.note: a later sale is offered on its own past the declined offset

scenarios.name: liquidated_at_loss
scenarios.note: realised P/L below zero

scenarios.name: liquidation_partial_cancelled
scenarios.note: a cancelled sale that filled half: half the units leave, its proceeds are banked

scenarios.name: liquidation_partial_closed
scenarios.note: a closed sale that executed less than asked

scenarios.name: liquidation_closed_unpriced
scenarios.note: units executed, proceeds not reported: the basis parks as an estimate, nothing is banked

scenarios.name: liquidation_alpaca_zero_quote
scenarios.note: Alpaca reports 0, not blank, before it knows the average price

scenarios.name: liquidation_more_than_held
scenarios.note: a sale of more units than the bot bought (units that reached the venue another way)

scenarios.name: liquidated_member_reentered
scenarios.note: CCC sold out, then back in the index: bought again from zero

scenarios.name: redeploy_closed_unpriced
scenarios.note: a redeploy buy closed with base executed and no quote figure: spent at price x amount

scenarios.name: redeploy_overshoot
scenarios.note: a redeploy fill above the proceeds: the excess books as a contribution

scenarios.name: rebalance_completed
scenarios.note: AAA over weight sold, CCC bought with the proceeds; then a scheduled buy

scenarios.name: rebalance_dust_then_regular
scenarios.note: the swap bought less than it sold; the next scheduled buy drains the flight cash

scenarios.name: rebalance_sell_only_completed
scenarios.note: a rebalance sell whose buy never landed (cleared below the venue floor): the cash stays in flight

scenarios.name: regular_sell_then_liquidation
scenarios.note: a scheduled sell before a liquidation and a scheduled buy after

scenarios.name: full_cycle
scenarios.note: regular, rebalance, liquidation, redeploy, regular sell and regular buy in one history

scenarios.name: liquidation_waiting
scenarios.note: a liquidation still working at the venue

scenarios.name: liquidation_partly_filled_open
scenarios.note: a liquidation partly filled and still working

scenarios.name: liquidation_unknown
scenarios.note: a liquidation accepted, status unknown

scenarios.name: liquidation_placing_intent
scenarios.note: a placement intent left by a dead worker (promoted to ambiguous)

scenarios.name: liquidation_ambiguous
scenarios.note: a placement whose outcome is unknown

scenarios.name: liquidation_abandoned_unresolved
scenarios.note: a liquidation the venue stopped reporting, not yet accounted for

scenarios.name: liquidation_abandoned_resolved
scenarios.note: the same row after the user attested to it (liquidation_resolved_orders)

scenarios.name: redeploy_waiting
scenarios.note: a redeploy buy still working

scenarios.name: redeploy_ambiguous
scenarios.note: a redeploy placement whose outcome is unknown

scenarios.name: redeploy_abandoned
scenarios.note: a redeploy the venue stopped reporting: not in flight by itself (Rails halts only when its own sweep abandons it)

scenarios.name: rebalance_selling
scenarios.note: a rebalance sell still working

scenarios.name: rebalance_buying
scenarios.note: a rebalance between its sell and its buy

scenarios.name: liquidation_rejected
scenarios.note: the venue rejected the liquidation before it traded

scenarios.name: redeploy_rejected
scenarios.note: the venue rejected the redeploy buy before it traded

scenarios.name: rebalance_rejected
scenarios.note: the venue rejected the rebalance sell before it traded

scenarios.name: rebalance_abandoned
scenarios.note: the buy leg the venue stopped reporting, the halt cleared: the flight cash may already be CCC
